name: Oskarn Station 14 Original
description: This listing is a graded tephra collector listed with accuracy class 0.53 percent, operating temperature 50 degrees Celsius, sampling rate 1066.6 hertz. Its remaining stated figures are calibration interval 8 months, unit price set after acceptance, mounting handheld. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.

reviews.title: Operating temperature of 50 degrees Celsius was the deciding figure
reviews.text: Shortlisted three graded tephra collector units and this listing was the one we kept. Its operating temperature of 50 degrees Celsius is what settled it. No complaints beyond the operating temperature of 50 degrees Celsius, and no surprises either.
